verdict.rationale: Atlas docs say founders can create, send, and track SAFEs from the Dashboard, and that Atlas provides legal documents developed with Cooley. That covers generating a SAFE on standard terms without drafting from scratch. missing for 10: explicit documentation that signing/countersigning happens in Atlas, detail on which standard SAFE terms are offered (e.g. valuation cap or discount options), any convertible note support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SAFE workflow.
